instruction: In my-pow the negative-exponent branch multiplies where it should divide. Swap the two operators so a negative exponent divides.
input:
(define (my-pow x n)
  ((if (< n 0) * /)
   (let loop ([x x] [n n] [result 1])
     (if (zero? n) result
       (loop (sqr x) (quotient n 2)
             (if (odd? n) (* x result) result))))))
expected:
(define (my-pow x n)
  ((if (< n 0) / *)
   (let loop ([x x] [n n] [result 1])
     (if (zero? n) result
       (loop (sqr x) (quotient n 2)
             (if (odd? n) (* x result) result))))))
